intervention_description: Multi-faceted intervention providing livestock assets, cash consumption stipend, skills training, coaching, and financial services to ultra-poor women

graduation_components_rationale.consumption_support: Monthly cash stipend of USD 54 PPP for 12 months
graduation_components_rationale.healthcare: Health subsidy including hygiene kit and medical expense reimbursement
graduation_components_rationale.assets: Transfer of livestock assets worth USD 1,136-1,488 PPP
graduation_components_rationale.skills_training: Basic training on livestock rearing and entrepreneurship
graduation_components_rationale.savings: Helped open bank accounts and promoted savings behavior
graduation_components_rationale.coaching: Biweekly mentoring visits by social organizers
graduation_components_rationale.social_empowerment: Indicators show improvements in community participation and social capital

outcomes.outcome_description: Total household consumption per capita in PPP USD per month
outcomes.literal_text: Per capita consumption increases by 30% (USD 24 purchasing power parity, USD 7 nominal per month)
Food security index increases by 0.49 standard deviations (p-value < 0.0005)

outcomes.outcome_description: Standardized index of savings behavior, account holdings, and credit access
outcomes.literal_text: Financial inclusion index increases by 2.38 standard deviations (FWER-corrected p-value < 0.0005)

outcomes.outcome_description: Standardized index of livestock asset ownership
outcomes.literal_text: Livestock assets index increases by 1.06 SD

outcomes.outcome_description: Total time spent working by primary woman in past 7 days
outcomes.literal_text: 55% increase in total time spent working of primary woman

outcomes.outcome_description: Total monthly household income in PPP USD
outcomes.literal_text: Total monthly household income increases by USD 69 PPP (p-value 0.007) from USD 307 PPP in control group

outcomes.outcome_description: Standardized psychological well-being index for primary woman
outcomes.literal_text: Psychological well-being index increases by 0.58 SD for primary woman

outcomes.outcome_description: Percentage of children under five with diarrhea in past two weeks
outcomes.literal_text: Diarrhea rate in children under five falls by 16%

outcomes.outcome_description: Percentage point increase in school enrollment for boys
outcomes.literal_text: School enrollment increases by 4.6 percentage points for boys

outcomes.outcome_description: Standardized index of women's empowerment indicators
outcomes.literal_text: Women's empowerment index increases by 0.38 standard deviations (p-value < 0.0005)
